summary: Count rows, browse Ravelry collections, and read your synced patterns offline.
page_description: Count rows for each section of a project, browse your Ravelry library, and read patterns you own offline.
release_notes: +1 row is the large filled control at the foot of the counter, beside Undo, and projects and the library moved to the top bar.

steps.text: Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Send a pattern you own. PDFs need Poppler's pdftotext on this computer.
Optional: Ravelry library sync needs an approved Ravelry API account. Install its credential under the name ravelry.
